SELECT u.id, u.email, u.display_name, u.job_role, u.level, u.role, u.email_verified_at, u.banned_at, u.created_at, (SELECT count(*) FROM lesson_progress p WHERE p.user_id = u.id)::int AS lessons_completed, (SELECT max(a.activity_date) FROM activity_days a WHERE a.user_id = u.id) AS last_active FROM users u
ORDER BY u.created_at DESC, u.id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM users)::int AS users, (SELECT count(*) FROM users WHERE email_verified_at IS NOT NULL)::int AS verified, (SELECT count(*) FROM users WHERE banned_at IS NOT NULL)::int AS banned, (SELECT count(*) FROM users WHERE created_at >= #{weekAgo})::int AS new_this_week, (SELECT count(DISTINCT user_id) FROM activity_days WHERE activity_date = #{today})::int AS active_today, (SELECT count(DISTINCT user_id) FROM activity_days WHERE activity_date >= #{weekAgoDate})::int AS active_this_week, (SELECT count(*) FROM lesson_progress)::int AS lessons_completed, (SELECT count(*) FROM video_progress)::int AS videos_completed, (SELECT count(*) FROM squads)::int AS squads, (SELECT count(*) FROM comments WHERE status = 'PENDING')::int AS pending_comments, COALESCE((SELECT requests FROM ai_global_usage WHERE usage_date = #{today}), 0) AS ai_requests_today
SELECT level, count(*)::int AS count FROM users WHERE level IS NOT NULL AND banned_at IS NULL GROUP BY level ORDER BY level
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET banned_at = #{at}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE users SET role = #{role}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT v.id, v.title, v.channel, v.category, v.youtube_id, v.hidden_at, (SELECT count(*) FROM video_progress p WHERE p.video_id = v.id)::int AS completions FROM videos v ORDER BY v.position
